deutivacaftor.name: Deutivacaftor
deutivacaftor.mechanism: CFTR channel gating potentiator; distinct deuterated drug, not ivacaftor.

dornase alfa.name: Dornase alfa
dornase alfa.mechanism: Enzymatic cleavage of extracellular DNA in airway secretions.

4d-710.name: 4D-710
4d-710.mechanism: AAV-mediated delivery of a functional shortened CFTR gene.

arct-032.name: ARCT-032
arct-032.mechanism: Delivery of CFTR mRNA in lipid nanoparticles.

rct2100.name: RCT2100
rct2100.mechanism: Lipid nanoparticle delivery of CFTR mRNA.

kb407.name: KB407
kb407.mechanism: Viral-vector delivery of full-length CFTR transgenes.

bi3720931.name: BI 3720931
bi3720931.mechanism: Inhaled lentiviral CFTR gene delivery; selected registrations are long-term follow-up without redosing.

spl84.name: SPL84
spl84.mechanism: Antisense correction of CFTR pre-mRNA splicing associated with 3849+10kb C>T.

pgm169-gl67a.name: pGM169/GL67A
pgm169-gl67a.mechanism: CFTR plasmid delivered in GL67A liposomes; GL67A is the delivery component, not an independent CFTR-binding drug. Matching EU trial results document completion in 2014; not ongoing evidence.

sp101.name: SP-101
sp101.mechanism: AAV-mediated CFTR minigene delivery with doxorubicin as a transduction augmenter. External development-status report conflicts with registry ongoing view.
sp101.programStatus: CFF reports discontinued; sponsor webpage and registry retain clinical/ongoing descriptions. Current active development not confirmed.

etd001.name: ETD001
etd001.mechanism: Inhibition of epithelial sodium channel to improve airway hydration.

abci.name: ABCI (amphotericin B cystetic for inhalation)
abci.mechanism: Amphotericin-based channel replacement formulation; CF-specific molecular mechanism not inferred from antifungal target annotations.

ang003.name: ANG003
ang003.mechanism: Pancreatic enzyme replacement containing lipase, protease and amylase activities; no single receptor target.

nhs7108.name: NHS7108
nhs7108.mechanism: Recombinant modified bacterial triacylglycerol lipase for enzyme replacement; no single human receptor target.

pancrelipase.name: Pancrelipase / pancreatic enzyme replacement
pancrelipase.mechanism: Lipase, protease and amylase replacement; no single molecular receptor target.

hypertonic-saline.name: Hypertonic saline
hypertonic-saline.mechanism: Osmotic airway hydration; no single molecular target assigned.

glp1.name: GLP-1 peptide
glp1.mechanism: Endogenous incretin receptor agonism; peptide formulation/isoform remains unresolved at ChEMBL-molecule level.

gip.name: GIP peptide
gip.mechanism: Glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide receptor agonism; exact peptide preparation not assigned a ChEMBL ID.

bx004.name: BX004
bx004.mechanism: Bacteriophage cocktail directed at Pseudomonas aeruginosa; molecular adsorption receptor not established.

achromophage.name: AchromoPhage
achromophage.mechanism: Bacteriophage therapy directed at Achromobacter lung infection; no molecular receptor inferred.

saspject.name: SASPject PT3.9
saspject.mechanism: Engineered phage antibacterial directed at Pseudomonas aeruginosa; no individual molecular receptor assigned.

iv-phage.name: Individualized intravenous bacteriophage cocktail
iv-phage.mechanism: Personalized bacteriophages plus standard antibiotics; neither a uniform cocktail composition nor a unique molecular target is established.

tamoxifen.name: tamoxifen
tamoxifen.mechanism: Selective estrogen receptor modulation. The CF protocol additionally proposes calcium-activated chloride conductance; a specific CaCC molecular isoform is not established here.

losartan.name: losartan
losartan.mechanism: Angiotensin II type 1 receptor antagonism; established general pharmacology does not by itself establish CF disease modification.

verapamil hydrochloride.name: verapamil hydrochloride
verapamil hydrochloride.mechanism: L-type calcium channel blockade; channel family rather than a uniquely established subtype.

rosuvastatin.name: rosuvastatin
rosuvastatin.mechanism: HMG-CoA reductase inhibition; registry uses rosuvastatin to investigate protection during aminoglycoside treatment.

levofloxacin.name: levofloxacin
levofloxacin.mechanism: Inhibition of bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV.

piperacillin.name: piperacillin
piperacillin.mechanism: Inhibition of bacterial cell-wall synthesis through penicillin-binding proteins; no species-specific single protein inferred.

tazobactam.name: tazobactam
tazobactam.mechanism: Inhibition of susceptible beta-lactamases; no individual bacterial enzyme assigned.

posenacaftor.name: posenacaftor
posenacaftor.mechanism: Correction of CFTR processing and trafficking

nesolicaftor.name: nesolicaftor
nesolicaftor.mechanism: Amplification of CFTR mRNA/protein expression; CFTR is a downstream functional gene product, not an established directly bound target

gdc6988.name: gdc6988
gdc6988.mechanism: Potentiation of the calcium-activated chloride channel TMEM16A (ANO1).

beclomethasone dipropionate.name: beclomethasone dipropionate
beclomethasone dipropionate.mechanism: Prodrug converted to beclomethasone-17-monopropionate with glucocorticoid-receptor activity.

flagella-vaccine.name: flagella-vaccine
flagella-vaccine.mechanism: Vaccination with Pseudomonas aeruginosa flagellar antigens; antigen-directed immunity, not direct receptor inhibition.

risedronate.name: Risedronate
risedronate.mechanism: Inhibition of human farnesyl diphosphate synthase, supported by structural and enzymatic studies.

colistin.name: Colistin
colistin.mechanism: Disruption of bacterial cell membranes; no individual protein receptor assigned.

doxorubicin.name: Doxorubicin
doxorubicin.mechanism: Transduction augmenter in the SP-101 regimen. General anticancer targets are not treated as the established molecular mechanism of CF transduction augmentation.

vx-272.name: VX-272
vx-272.mechanism: Identity established; no unique molecular target established by reviewed evidence.

vx-581.name: VX-581
vx-581.mechanism: Identity established; no unique molecular target established by reviewed evidence.

metformin hydrochloride.name: Metformin hydrochloride
metformin hydrochloride.mechanism: Identity established; no unique molecular target established by reviewed evidence.
